thread:
Priya Sharma: paging-oncall — seeing sustained 504s from dedicated-gpu-pool across us-west-2, started ~11:02 UTC. Customers showing increased error rates. I’m going to mute the noisy high-frequency alert for now and open a short maintenance window to reduce pager churn. tagging @Noah and @Jules for context.
Noah Li: on it — I'm looking at the LB logs and core runtime KPIs. Can you post the grafana panel link?
Priya Sharma: dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/dev/overview?panel=dedicated-gpu-pool — error spike lines up with autoscaler flapping around 11:01-11:05.
incident-bot: Incident created — INC-2026-1839123456, severity: P2, assigned: Priya Sharma.
Jules Park: ack. any customer-facing impact noted yet?
Priya Sharma: initial APM traces show higher tail latency for token gen requests -> some requests hit timeouts at the gateway level; support queue has 3 mentions from enterprise customers (no outages, but degraded).
Kai Morgan: quick sanity check: is this the same cause as yesterday's cache eviction bug? sequence lengths look normal.
Priya Sharma: looks different — KV cache hit-rate is stable. autoscaler logs show repeated instance spin-ups then immediate drains. suspect flapping due to sudden memory pressure on a subset of hosts.
monitoring-bot: Alert rule: dedicated-gpu-pool-504-rate fired (threshold: >3/min) — 350 alerts in last 5m.
Noah Li: ok, plan: 1) silence dedicated-gpu-pool-504-rate for 30m (to stop pages) 2) open maintenance window in monitoring for the dedicated pool 3) workflows: collect heap/oom logs from nodes that drained 4) rollback recent infra agent pushed at 10:58 if correlated.
Priya Sharma: executing now: `curl -X POST https://monitoring.redwood/api/silences -d '{"alert":"dedicated-gpu-pool-504-rate","duration":1800}'`
monitoring-bot: Silence created id=si-7890 for dedicated-gpu-pool-504-rate (expires in 30m).
Priya Sharma: maintenance window created: mw-4521 [11:04-11:40 UTC] for cluster:d-gpu-usw2.
Lena Ortiz: creating a short alert-pruning checklist for post-incident: - verify thresholds - ensure maintenance window removed - add runbook link to alert - adapt noise suppression rules - run synthetic smoke checks after changes. I’ll own follow-up.
Jules Park: thanks Lena. @Noah can you validate the autoscaler logs and post grep/snippet of error? if it’s the agent rollback we should revert.
Noah Li: grabbing logs now. found repeated: `kubelet: eviction notice: memory.available < threshold` on host gpu-12 and gpu-14 around 11:00. Also seeing `nvidia-mig-monitor` restart loop on gpu-14. Pushing full log snippet to thread.
Priya Sharma: pasting critical block: ```
11:00:21 kubelet: eviction: memory.available 120Mi < 200Mi
11:00:24 docker: container restart: runtime-proxy (exit 137)
11:01:02 nvidia-mig-monitor: restart
11:01:05 kube-proxy: draining node gpu-14
```
Kai Morgan: that matches hardware flake in that AZ. we should mark gpu-14 and gpu-12 as unschedulable and cordon them. I'll run `kubectl cordon gpu-14` and `drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` for both.
Priya Sharma: executing cordon/drain now.
incident-bot: Pager duty: on-call escalation suppressed due to active silence.
Priya Sharma: cordon + drain complete for gpu-14 and gpu-12. Traffic rebalanced, error rate dropping.
monitoring-bot: dedicated-gpu-pool-504-rate alert resolved (firing -> cleared).
Jules Park: nice work. next steps: revisit alert thresholds — the current 3/min is too sensitive during transient AZ flaps. propose: change to 10/min with a 1m aggregation window, plus a severity tier that only pages above 30/min.
Lena Ortiz: agreed. Add to post-incident actions: 1) update alert threshold as Jules proposes 2) add a short suppression policy for transient AZ flaps 3) create dashboard tile comparing 504-rate vs node-drain events for correlation 4) run manual validation after changes.
Priya Sharma: I want a quick smoke test before we remove silence: run 50 synthetic token-gen requests to several models to confirm latency < 1.5s p95. @Noah can you script that?
Noah Li: yup — `scripts/smoke/dedicated_pool_smoke.sh --count 50 --p95 1.5` will run in ~30s. posting results: 50/50 OK, p95=1.2s.
Priya Sharma: removing silence in 2m. will monitor for any re-firing.
monitoring-bot: Silence si-7890 scheduled to expire at 11:34 UTC; manual remove requested by Priya Sharma.
Priya Sharma: removed silence.
monitoring-bot: No new firing for dedicated-gpu-pool-504-rate in the last 10m.
Lena Ortiz: filling out incident follow-up doc: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-1839123456/postmortem — adding alert tuning tasks and owners.
Jules Park: for validation I'll update the alert rule to: `threshold: 10/min; aggregation: 60s; page_if > 30/min` and add `runbook_url: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/dedicated-gpu-504` in the alert metadata.
Priya Sharma: assigning post-incident items: Lena -> alert validation and dashboard, Jules -> alert rule update and runbook linkage, Kai -> infrastructure remediation for gpu nodes, Noah -> log/trace artifacts and synthetic smoke proof. I'll close INC-2026 once follow-ups are complete.
Jules Park: one more: set a short maintenance window template for expected AZ flaps (5m auto-expire) so we can quickly mute noise next time without manual create. I'll PR that to infra-monitoring.
Priya Sharma: thanks everyone. final status: customer impact limited to degraded tail latency; no data loss; mitigation: cordon/ drain of flaky nodes, silence + maintenance window, alert threshold adjusted draft. follow-ups tracked in confluence. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1839123456 transitioned to monitoring state (follow-ups assigned).
Priya Sharma: closing thread here; will update once follow-ups done.
